messages:
Nora Vega: Random but fun idea: Plant swap + Taco Tuesday in the courtyard next Tues? Bring a small plant cutting or starter and one taco (homemade or store-bought). low-key, label care instructions. 🌿🌮
Caleb Ortiz: 100% in. what time? lunch or evening?
Nora Vega: thinking 12:30pm so folks can step out midday. quick swap table and a taco line.
Maya Lin: love. i can bring two vegan tacos and some biodegradable plates.
Jonas Reed: ill bring a little succulents batch and some salsa verde. Heads up: my succulents are labeled with names. 😅
Priya Kapoor: i'll bring corn tortillas and a tiny stack of napkins. anyone have extra potting soil for repotting?
Zane Carter: i can bring a bag of soil and some tiny pots. please mark anything that needs bright light vs low light.
Lila Gomez: cute idea! can we do a quick 5-min "plant care note" pitch when swapping? like name, water cadence, light. optional.
Nora Vega: yes thats perfect—keeps the plants happy.
Caleb Ortiz: RSVP reaction: 👍 = in, ❓ = maybe, 👎 = out.
OpsBot: Event scheduled: "Plant Swap + Taco Tuesday" Tuesday 12:30 — Courtyard. Reminder 45m before.
Maya Lin: ✋ (in)
Jonas Reed: ✋
Priya Kapoor: ✋
Zane Carter: ✋
Lila Gomez: ✋
Caleb Ortiz: ✋
Nora Vega: quick logistics: cap at 20 so it's manageable. if more, we can rotate in 20-min shifts.
Maya Lin: label food for common allergens (dairy, gluten, nuts). i'll label my tacos vegan + contains onion.
Jonas Reed: small ask: if youre bringing cuttings, please bag them so soil doesn't spill. ill have some zip bags.
Priya Kapoor: anyone bringing scissors or clippers? i forgot mine at home.
Zane Carter: i have clippers and a little pruning kit. will bring it.
Lila Gomez: can someone bring a plant-friendly tray? my little pots leak when watered.
Caleb Ortiz: Ill bring a foldable tray and a small watering can.
Nora Vega: also if youre taking a plant home, please fill out a tiny note with your name and the plant name so we can track adoptions.
Maya Lin: love the "adoption" idea.
Jonas Reed: weather check: courtyard open-air but low chance of drizzle. rooftop backup?
Nora Vega: rooftop backup if weather bad. OpsBot set to update if forecast changes.
OpsBot: Weather alert set: update will post 2 hours before event if chance of rain >50%.
Caleb Ortiz: tiny contest idea: golden taco token hidden in one taco — winner gets a plant care kit. fun?
Priya Kapoor: yes please. i'm making one taco with a tiny ribbon toothpick. low-stakes.
Lila Gomez: accessibility note: keep a low-traffic table for folks who prefer quieter interactions.
Nora Vega: noted, will reserve the east bench area.
Zane Carter: parking/guests: if youre bringing a friend, sign them in at reception.
Maya Lin: playlist rec: chill Latin indie.
Jonas Reed: rec: Buena Vista Social Club track or two.
Nora Vega: RSVP tally: Nora, Caleb, Maya, Jonas, Priya, Zane, Lila = 7. cap 20.
Nora Vega: super excited—see y
ll Tuesday! bring tiny pots if you want to rehome a cutting on the spot. 🌱
